_doc: STORY SCENES for The Squeeze (Act I, Utah). A scene binds a background image, a music track, and an entry dialogue node. Chapter/act/milestone fields feed the spoken Quest Recap and the debug chapter-warp menu.

scenes.name: The Backroom Trench
scenes.ambientDescription: A dead building at 3:47 in the morning: hydraulic hiss at the bay, the ballast hum of the fluorescents, and forty-eight feet of freight still on the trailer.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You clocked in at a Wally's World overnight unload, learned the freight line, met the crew, and survived your first wall of boxes.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the floor, meet the crew, brew the coffee, and run the 4 AM unload.

scenes.name: The Sales Floor
scenes.ambientDescription: A hundred thousand square feet of concrete and shelving under a vaulted ceiling: the store wakes, the floor crews fan out, and someone has to be in charge of the freight lanes.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You were promoted to IMS2 Supervisor, led the overnight crews, fixed the process, and held the floor through a front-end storm.
scenes.defaultObjective: Lead the crew, fix the process, and stand your ground on the floor.

scenes.name: The Front End
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 3: The Rot and the Offer
scenes.ambientDescription: The registers at the edge of the building, where the machine meets the public: the layoffs flow through here, and every exit is a door somebody was walked through.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 3: The Rot and the Offer
scenes.milestoneSummary: You saw the machine up close at the front end, made a private vow, and Jodie offered you an assistant-coach slot in Colorado.
scenes.defaultObjective: Hear the offer, see the rot, and decide whether to take the door out.

scenes.name: The Manager's Office
scenes.ambientDescription: The manager's office at the end of the hall: a cheap desk, a wall of laminated posters, and a computer that has already sent the email.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You faced Mattie-T in her own office, survived the squeeze, and walked out to a truck pointed at Colorado.
scenes.defaultObjective: Face what Mattie-T built, survive the office, and choose your way out.
